[[Jonathan Blunt]] is a [[weaponsmith]], a type of [[NPC]] that [[craft]]s weapons in exchange for [[crafting material]]s and [[gold]] and/or [[customize]]s weapons. It costs 10 gold to get a weapon customized.

All weapons come equipped with an [[inherent]] [[Charr]]-related [[inscription]] or [[upgrade component]].
*Martial weapons, [[wand]]s, and [[staff|staves]] come with a [[Of slaying|Dmg +20% (vs. Charr)]] upgrade.
*[[Shield]]s and [[focus item]]s come with an [[Armor]] +10 (vs. Charr) upgrade.

The Charrslayer shields and focus items are unusual in that the Armor +10 (vs. Charr) inscription doesn't exist; however, inherent armor bonuses against Charr have been noted in [[Prophecies]] quest rewards and as infrequent [[drop]]s.
